entries.name: D&D 5e (basic)
entries.description: D&D 5e-compatible mechanics: abilities, skills & saves as proficiency rosters, spell slots, a weapons table. Mechanics only — no rulebook text.
entries.author: DM Toolkit
entries.changelogExcerpt: The Weapons table gained Cost and Weight columns, so an SRD weapons table imports without losing columns (v1.15.0).

entries.name: GURPS (basic)
entries.description: GURPS-compatible mechanics: ST/DX/IQ/HT, derived characteristics, HP/FP pools, skills, traits, weapons & DR tables. Mechanics only.
entries.author: DM Toolkit
entries.changelogExcerpt: The Equipment and Weapons tables are now item targets, so catalog items can be added straight into them (v1.10.0).

entries.name: D&D 5e SRD content
entries.description: The complete SRD 5.2.1 content for the dnd5e-basic ruleset: conditions, actions, common rules, every spell, the full bestiary, and every weapon, armor and adventuring item as catalog gear. Attach to a D&D campaign.

entries.name: DMTK Ruleset — Spotlight
entries.description: A ruleset for Daggerheart™ Compatible play, built from the Daggerheart SRD 2.0: the six traits, Hope and Stress, Armor Slots, the domain-card loadout and vault, Experiences, gold, free turn order and the GM's Fear. Mechanics only — no rules text.

entries.author: DM Toolkit
entries.changelogExcerpt: Hit Points, Stress and Armor Slots count up — marked, not left; Active Armor becomes a table with typed thresholds and weapons gain a Burden column; the loadout and vault take domain cards from the catalog; a suggested DM Screen (conditions, core rules, Fear, the party — no initiative); the unused Fear Features field is gone (v1.3.0).
